summary: RETEST after iteration_1 score-add bug fix. All 13 critical flows now pass on a 414x900 mobile viewport. The PlayerColumn refactor (local input state + explicit value passed to onAdd) successfully resolved the stale-closure bug. Verified: home → domino navigation, add score (p1 & p2) with total update + score item rendered + input cleared, multi-add summing correctly, delete score, target chips, custom target apply+clear, winner modal with correct winner name (أحمد reaching 100), new round (clears scores, keeps name+target), reset button via window.confirm (clears scores, keeps name+target), AsyncStorage persistence across reload, back button to home.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` is emitted on every page load — comes from a React Native dependency, low priority and not user-visible.

critical_code_review_comments: domino.tsx winner useEffect (lines 82-95) has a redundant tie-break branch — could be simplified to a single comparison, but functionally correct.
Files are well-sized (<700 lines each), tests pass cleanly. No further changes needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: URL https://ea7f7918-2981-4e31-91c2-73ee9bacb960.preview.emergentagent.com. Use viewport 414x900 (or 375x667). Score-add pipeline now fully working. Important nuance: testing back-button after page.reload() will fail with 'GO_BACK was not handled' — this is a browser-history artifact, not a real bug. Always test back button via natural flow (load home → tap game-card-domino → tap back-button). Use page.evaluate(()=>localStorage.clear()) before each fresh test run to remove persisted state.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 1 root cause was confirmed: addScore in the parent component closed over input1/input2 state which was being read stale when invoked from the (re-rendered) child. Iteration 2 fix lifted input state into PlayerColumn and passes the value as an explicit argument to onAdd(value), eliminating the closure. Verified by adding a score (30) → total updates to 30, item rendered, input cleared. All downstream features (multi-add, delete, winner, new round, reset, persistence) now work end-to-end.
